turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyTail:
and still have no tracking, where is it?
If you placed your order a few days ago and still don’t see tracking, it may simply still be in processing. For ready-to-ship pieces, processing typically takes 3–5 business days (plus shipping time). Made-to-order pieces take longer—roughly 4–6 weeks for production (plus shipping time). Exact processing timelines are listed on each product page.
If you’d like, tap Contact Support and our concierge team can look into your order with you.
Contact support

Do you compensate for a long delay?
We don’t have a stated policy that guarantees compensation for shipping delays—shipping times aren’t guaranteed, and delays can happen (especially during peak/holiday periods).
If your order is significantly delayed, the best next step is to contact our concierge team with your order number so they can review your specific shipment and see what options are available.
